definitions.full: H5717. Adiel עֲדִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( an ornament is El ; compare Sabean proper name עדאל Hal 51 Hal 2 ); — 1 a Simeonite 1Chr 4:36 , ᵐ5 A Εδιηλ , ᵐ5 L Αδαηλ . 2 a priest 1Chr 4:36 , ᵐ5 Αδιηλ . 3 father of officer, David's time 1Chr 27:25 , ᵐ5 Ωδιηλ — compare Gray Prop, N. 225, 231 .
